eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Jackson, OR; at 6:13 PM on AUG 13, 2026 Effective until 10:13 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Wildfire Alert - Jackson County Sheriff's Office has issued a Level 1 BE READY to evacuate for JAC-039 near 2300 to 4200 blk E Evans Creek and Earhart rd due to I5 Mile Marker 51 Fire. Monitor local news sources for evacuation and incident information.
